register.labelZh: GUN 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: gun for something 可以表示個人或團隊全力爭取冠軍、獎項、名額或職位。；gun for somebody 可以表示有人持續企圖擊敗、傷害或除去另一個人。；gun somebody down 常見於槍擊案和暴力襲擊的新聞報道。；gun for something 表示爭取目標;gun for somebody 表示針對某人;gun somebody down 則描述實際槍擊。
register.summaryEn: Gun for something can describe a person or team making a serious effort to win a title, prize, place or job. Gun for somebody can show that a person is repeatedly trying to defeat, harm or remove someone else. Gun somebody down often appears in reports about shootings and violent attacks. Gun for something concerns a goal. Gun for somebody concerns a human target. Gun somebody down describes an actual shooting.
contextsZh: 分辨爭取目標、針對他人和槍擊事件
